policies.name: Refund Policy 3.2
policies.summary: Standard purchases may be refunded to the original payment method within 30 days when eligibility checks pass.

policies.name: Billing Correction Policy 2.4
policies.summary: Duplicate charges and invoice errors may be corrected after transaction and account verification.

policies.name: Account Security Policy 5.1
policies.summary: Suspected account compromise requires identity verification and security escalation before account changes or sensitive disclosure.

policies.name: Privacy Request Policy 4.0
policies.summary: Access and deletion requests require identity verification, jurisdiction checks, retention review, and privacy-team processing.

policies.name: Customer Support Policy 1.8
policies.summary: Support may apologise, explain status, request evidence, and offer approved service recovery without making unverified commitments.

policies.name: Legal Escalation Policy 7.3
policies.summary: Threats of litigation, regulatory complaints, subpoenas, and admissions of liability must be routed to Legal without substantive response.
